rationale: All 28 unordered L0 core pairs are explicitly audited; absence of an edge is allowed when no direct mechanism is scientifically required.
Accepted scientific edges preserve mechanism, provenance, causal-language limits, boundaries, and context uncertainty.
Provisional edges remain explicit rather than being promoted through plausibility alone.
A direct social-feedback reward-learning loop now represents a major recurrent social-media mechanism with experimental and large-scale behavioral support.
Mixed arousal-to-sharing evidence retains preregistered null replications rather than forcing a positive edge.
Construct-mismatch non-edges such as trustworthiness->subjective utility and PSR->habit remain explicitly rejected.
No empirical effect size or legacy graph weight is used as a runtime propagation coefficient.
